noAccount.body: To connect, your Instagram account must be a Business or Creator account linked to a Facebook Page you manage.
noAccount.step1: In the Instagram app, open Settings → Account type and tools → Switch to professional account (Business or Creator).
noAccount.step2: Link it to a Facebook Page: Edit profile → Page → Connect or create a Page.

notes.publishing: Posts are published to Instagram as one image with its caption. Images are converted to JPEG and centre-cropped if their shape is outside what Instagram allows (4:5 to 1.91:1).
notes.dms: Instagram DMs get an AI reply draft in the Engagement approval queue; nothing is sent until you approve it. Keyword replies answer matching comments publicly and can send a private DM (Instagram private replies).
notes.trends: Trending audio and hashtags aren't available from Instagram's API, so these lists stay empty for your account.

permissionNames.pages_manage_metadata: managing your Page's settings (needed for DM webhooks)
